body.name: Finite common-rank inversion algorithm
body.construction: Given \(K,L,y,p^{1:L},N,\alpha\), all endpoints of \(I^{\mathrm{CP}}_{zdk}\), and the arrays \(A_\gamma,B_\gamma,b_\gamma,C_\gamma\), enumerate \(\Gamma_K=\Omega(p^{1:L})\times\Sigma_K\); construct every \(\mathcal P_\gamma\); output \(C_n=\bigcup_\gamma\{C_\gamma x:(q',x)\in\mathcal P_\gamma\}\) and the common-parameter representation of \(\mathcal H_n\); encode \(d_H\le r\), \(r_n^{\mathrm{out}}\), and \(r_n^{\mathrm{set}}\) as quantified linear-real formulas over these systems; eliminate quantifiers and isolate the relevant infimum or supremum boundary in \(r\). Let \(v_{\mathrm{alg}}\) and \(m_{\mathrm{alg}}\) be, respectively, the largest numbers of real variables and scalar affine atoms in any generated formula.
